newsitem.title: USA: Medical Action predicts positive FY98.
newsitem.headline: Medical Action predicts positive FY98.

text.p: Medical Action Industries Inc said Tuesday that it expects to see growth in both sales and earnings in its fiscal 1998.
The company said it will grow through a combination of higher sales and earnings as well as an aggressive acquisition plan.
In fiscal 1998, Medical Action said sales would grow by double digits, with net income outpacing revenue growth, if current trends continued.

Paul Meringola, president and chief operating officer of Medical Action, also said the company's new manufacturing facility in Arden, N.C., will become operational in September and will allow the company to reduce manufacturing costs throught environmental control.
